title: Why is Google Maps back to showing old satellite images of Altadena?
summary: Users on Reddit are questioning why Google Maps continues to display outdated satellite imagery of Altadena, a community that was significantly impacted by recent California wildfires. The post has gained moderate traction with 36 points and 20 comments, suggesting this is a shared frustration among local residents wanting to see current post-disaster conditions on the mapping platform.
problem_solved: This post doesn't solve a problem but raises awareness about Google Maps' delayed satellite imagery updates for disaster-affected areas.
why_valuable: It highlights the gap between real-world events and map data currency, demonstrating how outdated geographic data can be frustrating for affected communities and emergency responders.
